question_text_original: Find the maximum point（s）of the graph of $y=\frac{x^{2}+3 x+3}{x+2}$ .
question_text_zh: 求 $y=\frac{x^{2}+3 x+3}{x+2}$ 的图像上的极大点。
question_text_zh_reviewed: 求曲线 $y=\frac{x^2+3x+3}{x+2}$（$x\ne-2$）的极大点。
question_latex: Find the maximum point（s）of the graph of $y=\frac{x^{2}+3 x+3}{x+2}$ .
solution_original:
\begin{aligned}
& y= \frac{x^{2}+3 x+3}{x+2} \\
& \frac{d y}{d x}= \frac{(x+2)(2 x+3)-\left(x^{2}+3 x+3\right)(1)}{(x+2)^{2}} \\
&= \frac{x^{2}+4 x+3}{(x+2)^{2}} \\
& \frac{d y}{d x}=0 \\
& x^{2}+4 x+3=0 \\
& x=-3 \text { or }-1
\end{aligned}
$$

由於 $\frac{d y}{d x}$ 已經是一個頗複雜的有理函數,再用二階導數判別法會更複雜,故此應用一階導數判別法。

\begin{tabular}[t]{|l|l|l|l|l|l|l|l|}
\hline $x$ & $x<-3$ & －3 & $-3<x<-2$ & －2 & $-2<x<-1$ & －1 & $x>-1$ \\
\hline $\frac{d y}{d x}$ & ＋ & 0 & － & undefined未下定義 & － & 0 & ＋ \\
\hline
\end{tabular}

Hence,（－3,－3）is a maximum point.
由此,（－3,－3）為極大點。

當 $x=-3$ 時,
$$
y=\frac{(-3)^{2}+3(-3)+3}{(-3)+2}=-3
$$

x & =1 \text { or } x=4
\end{aligned}
$$

question_latex: Define $f(x)=\frac{x^{2}+5 x+1}{x+2}$ for all $x \neq-2$ .Denote the graph of $y=f(x)$ by $C$ .Find the asymptote（s）of $C$ .
solution_original:
Note that $x=-2$ is the vertical asymptote.
1A
留意,$x=-2$ 為垂直漸近線。
$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x) & =\frac{x^{2}+5 x+1}{x+2} \\
& =\frac{x^{2}+2 x+3 x+1}{x+2} \\
& =\frac{x^{2}+2 x+3 x+6-5}{x+2} \\
& =\frac{x(x+2)+3(x+2)-5}{x+2} \\
& =x+3-\frac{5}{x+2}
\end{aligned}
$$

當 $x=-2$ 時,分母 $x+2=0$ 。

1M
Note that $\frac{5}{x+2} \rightarrow 0$ when $x \rightarrow \pm \infty$ .
$\therefore y=x+3$ is the oblique asymptote.

也可運用長除法：
$$
x + 2 \longdiv { x ^ { 2 } + 5 x + 1 } . 0
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\therefore \quad f(x) & =\frac{(x+3)(x+2)-5}{x+2} \\
& =x+3-\frac{5}{x+2}
\end{aligned}
$$

留意,當 $x \rightarrow \pm \infty$ 時,$\frac{5}{x+2} \rightarrow 0$ 。
$\therefore y=x+3$ 為斜漸近線。
solution_verified:
当 $x=-2$ 时分母为零而分子为 $-5\ne0$，故 $x=-2$ 是垂直渐近线。又
$$f(x)=\frac{x^2+5x+1}{x+2}=x+3-\frac{5}{x+2}.$$
当 $x\to\pm\infty$ 时，$-\frac{5}{x+2}\to0$，故 $y=x+3$ 是斜渐近线。答案为 $x=-2$ 及 $y=x+3$。

Find the rate of change of the area of $\triangle O P Q$ when $u=2$ .
solution_original:
Let $A$ square units be the area of the circle with $O P$ as a radius.
設 $A$ 平方單位為以 $O P$ 為半徑的圓的面積。
\[
A=\pi(u^{2}+v^{2}),\qquad
\frac{dA}{dt}=\pi\left(2u\frac{du}{dt}+2v\frac{dv}{dt}\right)=-8\pi.
\]
Hence
\[
u\frac{du}{dt}+v\frac{dv}{dt}=-4,
\qquad v=2^{u-1},
\]
and therefore
\[
\frac{du}{dt}=\frac{-4}{u+2^{2u-2}\ln 2}.
\]
At \(u=2\), \(\frac{du}{dt}=\frac{-2}{1+2\ln2}\).

Let $S$ square units be the area of $\triangle O P Q$ .
設 $S$ 平方單位為 $\triangle O P Q$ 的面積。
$$
\begin{gathered}
S=\frac{1}{2} u v=\frac{1}{2} u\left(2^{u-1}\right)=u 2^{u-2} \\
\frac{d S}{d t}=\left[u(\ln 2) 2^{u-2}+2^{u-2}\right] \frac{d u}{d t} \\
=(1+u \ln 2) 2^{u-2} \frac{d u}{d t} \\
\left.\frac{d S}{d t}\right|_{u=2}=\left.(1+2 \ln 2) \frac{d u}{d t}\right|_{u=2} \\
=(1+2 \ln 2)\left(\frac{-2}{1+2 \ln 2}\right) \\
=-2
\end{gathered}
$$
$\therefore \quad$ The required rate of change is－2 square units per second.
所求的變率為每秒－2平方單位。

question_text_original:
A container in the form of an inverted right circular cone is held vertically.The height and the slant height of the container are 32 cm and 40 cm respectively.Initially,the container is full of water.Then,water is leaked from the apex of the conical container.

question_text_zh:
将一倒置直立圆锥形的容器垂直放置。该容器的高度及斜高分别为32cm 及40 cm 。起初,该容器装满了水。随后,水由该圆锥形容器的顶点漏出。
(a) 设 $A \mathrm{~cm}^{2}$ 为该容器被浸湿的曲面面积及 $h \mathrm{~cm}$ 为容器内的水深。以 $h$ 表 $A$ 。
(b) 该容器内的水的体积以恒速率 $9 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3} / \mathrm{s}$ 减少。求当该容器内的水深为 2 cm 时该容器被浸湿的曲面面积的变率。

solution_original:
12.Reference：HKDSE Math M2 2017 Q6
(a) Base radius of the container
$$
\begin{aligned}
& =\sqrt{40^{2}-32^{2}} \mathrm{~cm} \quad \text { (Pyth. theorem) } \\
& =24 \mathrm{~cm}
\end{aligned}
$$
Curved surface of the container $=\pi(24)(40)=960 \pi$ 1M
$$
\begin{aligned}
A & =960 \pi\left(\frac{h}{32}\right)^{2} \\
& =\frac{15}{16} \pi h^{2}
\end{aligned}
$$
1M
1A
(b) Let $V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$ be the volume of water in the container.
$$
\text { Note that } V=\frac{1}{3} \pi\left(\frac{3 h}{4}\right)^{2} h=\frac{3 \pi h^{3}}{16}
$$
1M
$$
\frac{d V}{d t}=\frac{9 \pi h^{2}}{16} \cdot \frac{d h}{d t}
$$
When $h=2$ ,
$$
-9 \pi=\left.\frac{9 \pi(2)^{2}}{16} \cdot \frac{d h}{d t}\right|_{h=2}
$$
$$
\left.\frac{d h}{d t}\right|_{h=2}=-4
$$
1A
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \text { By (a), } \\
& A=\frac{15}{16} \pi h^{2} \\
& \begin{aligned}
& \frac{d A}{d t}=\frac{15}{8} \pi h \frac{d h}{d t} \\
&\left.\therefore \quad \frac{d A}{d t}\right|_{h=2}=\frac{15}{8} \pi(2)(-4) \\
&=-15 \pi
\end{aligned}
\end{aligned}
$$
Thus,the required rate of change is $-15 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2} / \mathrm{s}$ .
solution_verified: 由勾股定理，容器底面半径为 $24\text{ cm}$。相似圆锥给出水面半径 $r=\frac34h$、水的斜高 $l=\frac54h$。(a) $A=\pi rl=\frac{15}{16}\pi h^2$。(b) 水体积 $V=\frac13\pi r^2h=\frac3{16}\pi h^3$，故 $\frac{dV}{dt}=\frac9{16}\pi h^2\frac{dh}{dt}$。当 $h=2$ 且 $\frac{dV}{dt}=-9\pi$ 时，$\frac{dh}{dt}=-4\text{ cm/s}$。又 $\frac{dA}{dt}=\frac{15}{8}\pi h\frac{dh}{dt}$，所以所求变率为 $-15\pi\text{ cm}^2/\text{s}$。

solution_verified: (a) $P=(r,\ln r)$，切线斜率为 $1/r$。设 $Q=(a,0)$，则 $\frac{-\ln r}{a-r}=\frac1r$，故 $Q=(r-r\ln r,0)$。(b) $OP=\sqrt{r^2+(\ln r)^2}$，所以 $\frac{d(OP)}{dt}=\frac{r^2+\ln r}{r\sqrt{r^2+(\ln r)^2}}\frac{dr}{dt}$。在 $r=\sqrt e$ 时令左边为 $2$，可得 $\frac{dr}{dt}=\frac{2\sqrt e\sqrt{e+1/4}}{e+1/2}$。此时 $Q$ 的横坐标为正，面积 $A=\frac12r(1-\ln r)\ln r$，故 $\frac{dA}{dr}=\frac12[1-\ln r-(\ln r)^2]$。代入 $r=\sqrt e$ 得 $\frac{dA}{dt}=\frac{\sqrt{4e^2+e}}{4(2e+1)}\approx0.221$ 平方单位/分钟。

$$
\begin{aligned}

\end{aligned}

Area of $\triangle O P Q$
$$
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{1}{2}[\sqrt{1-k}-(-\sqrt{1-k})] k \text { square units } \\

\end{aligned}
$$
(b) Let $A$ square units be the area of $\triangle O P Q$ .
$$
\begin{aligned}
& \text { By (a), } A=k\sqrt{1-k} \\
& \frac{d A}{d k}=\frac{2 k-3 k^{2}}{2 \sqrt{k^{2}-k^{3}}}
\end{aligned}
$$
So,we have $\frac{d A}{d k}=0 \Leftrightarrow k=\frac{2}{3}$ or $k=0$（rejected）.

\begin{tabular}[t]{|l|l|l|l|}
\hline $k$ & $\left(0, \frac{2}{3}\right)$ & $\frac{2}{3}$ & $\left(\frac{2}{3}, 1\right)$ \\
\hline $\frac{d A}{d k}$ & ＋ & 0 & － \\
\hline
\end{tabular}
$\therefore \quad A$ attains its greatest value when $k=\frac{2}{3}$ .
When $k=\frac{2}{3}, A=\frac{2}{3} \sqrt{1-\frac{2}{3}}=\frac{2}{3 \sqrt{3}}=\frac{2 \sqrt{3}}{9}$
∴ The greatest area of $\triangle O P Q$ is $\frac{2 \sqrt{3}}{9}$ square units.
(c)

$\frac{d A}{d t}=\left(\frac{d A}{d k}\right)\left(\frac{d k}{d t}\right)$

solution_verified:
(a) $PQ=\sqrt{(p-10)^2+9}+\sqrt{p^2+4}$。令导数为0并利用 $0<p<10$，得 $p=4$，故 $a=4$。
(b)(i) 面积 $A=\frac12p\,PQ$。在 $p=4$ 时 $d(PQ)/dp=0$，但 $dA/dp=PQ/2=5\sqrt5/2\ne0$，所以不同意。(ii) $OP=\sqrt{2p^2+4}$；在 $p=4$ 且 $d(OP)/dt=2$ 时，$dp/dt=3/2$。又 $OQ=\sqrt{p^2+(p-10)^2+9}$。设周长为 $w=OP+OQ+PQ$，则在 $p=4$ 时 $d(PQ)/dp=0$、$d(OQ)/dp=-2/\sqrt{61}$，故 $dw/dt=2-3/\sqrt{61}=2-3\sqrt{61}/61$ 单位/秒。

question_latex: It is given that the curve $x \ln y^{2}+y^{2}=9$ cuts the $y$－axis at two points.Find the equations of the tangents to the curve at these two points.
solution_original:
Reference：HKDSE Math M2 2014 Q3
When $x=0, y= \pm 3$ .
1A
Differentiate both sides of the equation of the curve with respect to $x$ ,
$$
x\left(\frac{2 y}{y^{2}} \times \frac{d y}{d x}\right)+\ln y^{2}+2 y \frac{d y}{d x}=0
$$
$1 \mathrm{M}+1 \mathrm{M}$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{d y}{d x} & =-\frac{\ln y^{2}}{\frac{2 x}{y}+2 y} \\
& =-\frac{y \ln y^{2}}{2 x+2 y^{2}}
\end{aligned}
$$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\left.\frac{d y}{d x}\right|_{(0,3)} & =-\frac{3 \ln 9}{18}=-\frac{\ln 3}{3} \\
\left.\frac{d y}{d x}\right|_{(0,-3)} & =-\frac{(-3) \ln 9}{18}=\frac{\ln 3}{3}
\end{aligned}
$$
$\therefore \quad$ At $(0,3)$ ,the equation of the tangent is $y=-\frac{x \ln 3}{3}+3$. $\_\_\_\_$ 1A
At（0,－3）,the equation of the tangent is $y=\frac{x \ln 3}{3}-3$ .

solution_original:
10.Reference：HKDSE Math M2 2021 Q5
(a) The equation of the vertical asymptote is $x=1$ . 1A
Note that $r(x)=\frac{x^{3}-3 x^{2}+3 x+11}{(x-1)^{2}}$
$$
\begin{aligned}
& =\frac{x^{3}-3 x^{2}+3 x-1+12}{(x-1)^{2}} \\
& =\frac{(x-1)^{3}+12}{(x-1)^{2}} \\
& =x-1+\frac{12}{(x-1)^{2}}
\end{aligned}
$$
1M
Thus,the equation of the oblique asymptote is $y=x-1$ . 1A f.t.
(b) $\frac{d}{d x} r(x)=\frac{d}{d x}\left[x-1+\frac{12}{(x-1)^{2}}\right]$
$$
=\underline{\underline{\underline{1-\frac{24}{(x-1)^{3}}}}}
$$
1A
(c) Note that $r^{\prime \prime}(x)=\frac{72}{(x-1)^{4}}>0$ for all $x$ .
i.e.$\quad r^{\prime \prime}(x)$ does not change sign for all $x$ . 1M
Therefore,the graph of $y=r(x)$ does not have any point of inflexion. 1A f.t. （6）
solution_verified:
先化为 $r(x)=x-1+12/(x-1)^2$。
(a) 垂直渐近线为 $x=1$，斜渐近线为 $y=x-1$。
(b) $r'(x)=1-24/(x-1)^3$。
(c) $r''(x)=72/(x-1)^4>0$（$x\ne1$），曲线在定义域各区间内均凹向上；$x=1$ 又不在定义域内，故没有拐点，数目为0。

\end{aligned}

question_text_original: The volume $V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$ of water in a glass is given by $V=\frac{\pi\left(h^{3}+3 h^{2}+3 h\right)}{12}(0 \leq h \leq 4)$ , where $h$ cm is the depth of water in the glass.Initially,the glass is full of water.There is a small hole at the bottom and water leaks out at a constant rate of $\pi \mathrm{cm}^{3} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ .Find the rate of change of the depth of water when the depth of water is 3 cm.
question_text_zh: 一玻璃杯中水的体积 $V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$ 可用公式 $V=\frac{\pi\left(h^{3}+3 h^{2}+3 h\right)}{12}(0 \leq h \leq 4)$ 算出,其中$h \mathrm{~cm}$ 为杯中水的深度。最初,杯里装满了水。杯的底部有一个小孔,水以 $\pi \mathrm{cm}^{3} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$的恒速率漏出。求当水的深度为 3 cm 时水的深度的变率。
question_text_zh_reviewed: 玻璃杯中水的体积 $V\,\mathrm{cm}^3$ 由 $V=\dfrac{\pi(h^3+3h^2+3h)}{12}$ 给出，其中 $0\le h\le4$，$h\,\mathrm{cm}$ 为水深。起初杯中装满水；杯底有一小孔，水以恒定速率 $\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^3\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$ 漏出。求水深为 $3\,\mathrm{cm}$ 时水深的变化率。
question_latex: The volume $V \mathrm{~cm}^{3}$ of water in a glass is given by $V=\frac{\pi\left(h^{3}+3 h^{2}+3 h\right)}{12}(0 \leq h \leq 4)$ , where $h$ cm is the depth of water in the glass.Initially,the glass is full of water.There is a small hole at the bottom and water leaks out at a constant rate of $\pi \mathrm{cm}^{3} \mathrm{~s}^{-1}$ .Find the rate of change of the depth of water when the depth of water is 3 cm.
solution_verified: $dV/dh=\pi(h+1)^2/4$，而漏水表示 $dV/dt=-\pi\,\mathrm{cm}^3\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$。由链式法则 $dV/dt=[\pi(h+1)^2/4]dh/dt$。当 $h=3$ 时，$-\pi=4\pi\,dh/dt$，故 $dh/dt=-1/4\,\mathrm{cm}\,\mathrm{s}^{-1}$。负号表示水深下降。

question_text_original:
Consider the curve $C: y=4 \ln x$ ,where $x>1$ .Let $O$ be the origin and $P$ be a point lying on $C$ .The vertical line which passes through $P$ cuts the $x$－axis at the point $Q$ .Denote the $x$－coordinate of $Q$ by $u$ .
(a) Express the area of $\triangle O P Q$ in terms of $u$ .
(b) If $P$ moves along $C$ such that $P Q$ decreases at a constant rate of 4 units per second, find the rate of change of the area of $\triangle O P Q$ when $u=e$ .
question_text_zh:

(a) 以 $u$ 表 $\triangle O P Q$ 的面积。
(b) 若 $P$ 沿 $C$ 移动使得 $P Q$ 以每秒4单位的恒速率减少,求当 $u=e$ 时 $\triangle O P Q$ 的面积的变率。

(a) 用 $u$ 表示 $\triangle OPQ$ 的面积。
(b) 若 $P$ 沿 $C$ 移动，使 $PQ$ 以每秒4单位的恒定速率缩短，求当 $u=e$ 时 $\triangle OPQ$ 面积的变化率。

(a) Express the area of $\triangle O P Q$ in terms of $u$ .

solution_original:
14.Reference：HKDSE Math M2 2016 Q3
(a) 
$$
\begin{aligned}
\text { Area } & =\frac{1}{2}(u)(4 \ln u) \text { square units } \\
& =\underline{\underline{2 u \ln u \text { square units }}}
\end{aligned}
$$
1A
(b) Let $v$ units be the length of $P Q$ and $A$ square units be the area of $\triangle O P Q$ .
$$
\begin{aligned}
& v=4 \ln u \\
& \therefore \quad \frac{d v}{d t}=\frac{4}{u} \times \frac{d u}{d t}
\end{aligned}
$$
Note that $\frac{d v}{d t}=-4$ .When $u=e$ ,we have
$$
-4=\frac{4}{e} \times\left.\frac{d u}{d t}\right|_{u=e}
$$
i.e.
$$
\left.\frac{d u}{d t}\right|_{u=e}=-e
$$
1A
$A=2 u \ln u$
$$
\begin{aligned}
\frac{d A}{d t} & =\left(2 u \times \frac{1}{u}+2 \ln u\right) \times \frac{d u}{d t} \\
& =(2+2 \ln u) \frac{d u}{d t}
\end{aligned}
$$
$\left.\frac{d A}{d t}\right|_{u=e}=(2+2 \ln e)(-e)$
$$
=-4 e
$$
$\therefore \quad$ The rate of change of the area of $\triangle O P Q$ is $-4 e$ square units per second. 1A
solution_verified:
(a) $P=(u,4\ln u)$、$Q=(u,0)$，故面积 $A=\tfrac12(u)(4\ln u)=2u\ln u$ 平方单位。
(b) 令 $v=PQ=4\ln u$，则 $dv/dt=(4/u)du/dt$。已知 $dv/dt=-4$，所以当 $u=e$ 时 $du/dt=-e$。又 $dA/dt=(2+2\ln u)du/dt$，故在 $u=e$ 时 $dA/dt=-4e$ 平方单位每秒。

question_text_original: Find the equations of the two tangents to the curve $C: x^{2}+2 x y-y^{2}=1$ which pass through the point $A(0,-1)$ .
question_text_zh: 求曲线 $C: x^{2}+2 x y-y^{2}=1$ 的两条通过点 $A(0,-1)$ 的切线的方程。

solution_original:
Reference：HKDSE Math M2 PP Q9
$x^{2}+2 x y-y^{2}=1$
Differentiating both sides with respect to $x$ ,
$$
\begin{aligned}
2 x+2 x \frac{d y}{d x}+2 y-2 y \frac{d y}{d x} & =0 \\
\frac{d y}{d x} & =\frac{x+y}{y-x}
\end{aligned}
$$
1M
Let $P(a, b)$ be the point of contact.
$$
\begin{align*}
\left.\frac{d y}{d x}\right|_{(a, b)} & =\text { Slope of } P A \\
\frac{a+b}{b-a} & =\frac{b+1}{a} \\
a^{2}+a b & =b^{2}-a b+b-a \\
a^{2}+2 a b-b^{2} & =b-a \tag{()}
\end{align*}
$$
Since $P(a, b)$ is a point on $C$ ,we have
$$
\begin{equation*}
a^{2}+2 a b-b^{2}=1 \tag{2}
\end{equation*}
$$
（1）－（2）：
$$
\begin{align*}
& 0=b-a-1 \\
& b=a+1 \ldots \ldots . \tag{3}
\end{align*}
$$
1M
Substituting（3）into（2）,
$$
\begin{aligned}
a^{2}+2 a(a+1)-(a+1)^{2} & =1 \\
2 a^{2} & =2 \\
a & =1 \text { or }-1
\end{aligned}
$$
1A

When $a=1, b=1+1=2$ .
The equation of the tangent is
$$
\begin{aligned}
y-2 & =\frac{2+1}{1}(x-1) \\
3 x-y-1 & =0
\end{aligned}
$$

1A
When $a=-1, b=-1+1=0$ .
The equation of the tangent is
$$
\begin{aligned}
y-0 & =\frac{0+1}{-1}[x-(-1)] \\
x+y+1 & =0
\end{aligned}
$$

1A

solution_verified: 隐式求导得 $dy/dx=(x+y)/(y-x)$。设切点为 $P(a,b)$，则 $P$ 在曲线上，且切线经过 $A$，所以 $(a+b)/(b-a)=(b+1)/a$。结合 $a^2+2ab-b^2=1$ 得 $b=a+1$，继而 $a=1$ 或 $a=-1$。相应切点为 $(1,2)$、$(-1,0)$，两条切线分别为 $3x-y-1=0$ 和 $x+y+1=0$。可能的竖直切线不经过 $A$，故没有遗漏。

solution_original:
9.The equation of the vertical asymptote is $x=-4$ . 1A
$$
\begin{aligned}
f(x) & =\frac{4 x^{2}-5 x+1}{x+4} \\
& =\frac{4\left(x^{2}+4 x\right)-21 x+1}{x+4} \\
& =\frac{4 x(x+4)-21(x+4)+1+84}{x+4} \\
& =4 x-21+\frac{85}{x+4}
\end{aligned}
$$
1M
Thus,the equation of the oblique asymptote is $y=4 x-21$ . 1A

solution_verified: 因分母在 $x=-4$ 为零而分子值为85，故垂直渐近线为 $x=-4$。多项式除法得 $f(x)=4x-21+85/(x+4)$，余项在 $x\to\pm\infty$ 时趋于0，故斜渐近线为 $y=4x-21$。
